old_target: SPON2 -> alpha4beta1 integrin complex -> adhesion/migration and immune-cell recruitment
new_target: SPON2 -> alpha4beta1 integrin complex -> adhesion/migration and immune-cell recruitment
decision_basis: Primary mouse immune-cell studies support SPON2/Mindin-dependent adhesion and recruitment through an alpha4beta1-containing integrin complex, based on alpha4 and beta1 blockade/perturbation. This supports a bounded complex-level functional edge, not standalone ITGA4 binding or a terminal TF relay.
